speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Border Defense Fortress. Independent power. Local targeting. The depot blackout bought us this approach, but it did not silence these guns.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: No patrol feed to follow now. Just sightlines and bad intentions. There’s a service road beneath the western gun deck.

speaker: TITAN
text: Look where those guns are pointed. Inward. They built a wall around people and called it protection.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: There are homes beyond that concrete. Keep the fighting on this side. We’re opening a crossing, not giving them another fire.

speaker: AURA
text: One signal ahead. Close, steady. Someone is holding their ground under all that interference. Let me bring them through.

speaker: SURYA
text: This is Surya Prime. Stay below the gun deck. I can shelter the gate road, but you’ll have to reach me.

speaker: KAITO
text: We came from the depot. Five of us. Hold your position, Surya. We’ll get to you together.

speaker: VOSS
text: Border Commander Voss. This crossing is closed. Return to your assigned district. You will not receive another warning.

speaker: SURYA
text: Five years of warnings. Five years of people waiting on opposite sides of that wall. I have heard enough.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Fortress vents are superheated. A laser curtain guards the inner approach. Reach Surya first. Then advance toward the command arena.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: I’ll find the gaps between their searchlights. When we reach that laser curtain, follow my lead. One problem at a time.

speaker: KAITO
text: No one crosses alone. Surya, keep that light burning. Squad—move.
